scope: All migrated image-rendering components; existing Next sources used as the behavior reference, not byte-identical generated URLs.

implementation.service: Astro Sharp for authorized non-Storyblok sources and explicit transforms; Storyblok width-only CDN URLs retain legacy CSS crop semantics. The former incomplete external service is no longer configured.
implementation.formats: AVIF-first picture source plus Astro WebP fallback for JPEG/PNG; explicit formats supported; animated inputs keep Astro default handling; Storyblok retains CDN negotiation.
implementation.publicAssets: Public raster assets are measured and passed as ImageMetadata with their filesystem path, allowing static and Node SSR optimization. LUMEN_PUBLIC_DIR must point to the consumer public directory, as configured by scripts/astro-site.cjs.
implementation.consumerSetup: Independent consumers import lumenImageConfig from lumen-cms-astro/images/config and set image: lumenImageConfig in their Astro config.

components.review: Measured/CMS intrinsic dimensions, square fill, proportional sizing, shape styles, eager/preload, inline SVG branch.
Fixed viewport size, CSS cover, responsive size hint.
Fixed image dimensions and responsive hint; decorative alt retained.
Intrinsic aspect ratio, fixed logo sizing, quality 95 and preload for toolbar; drawer branding retains lazy loading and quality 75.
CSS fill/fit/position, orientation variants, priority/preload, quality, lazy override.
Intrinsic ratio, original alt, section priority, eager override, restored blur placeholder and cleanup.
Fill without fabricated intrinsic dimensions; aspect ratio remains on container; CSS fit/position and sizes retained.
Fill, theme/column responsive hints, object-fit including auto, border radius.
Fill, configured width hint, CSS fit, responsive candidates.
Measured natural ratio and configured proportional height, fixed-size hint; existing scrolling behavior retained.
Intrinsic dimensions and responsive column hints; same renderer covers lightbox with 100vw sizing.
Fixed sizes, cover fit, responsive source sets; server-rendered pagination uses same wrapper.
Authorized Shopify optimization, CSS contain fill and column sizes.
Authorized Shopify optimization, 40px thumbnails, cover fit; templates retain generated assets.
150px team image, remote Vercel host optimization, lazy default.
Preserved ordinary img behavior for arbitrary WordPress sources; legacy did not use next/image.

intentionalUnoptimized: Inline SVGs, SVG URLs (including query strings), data/blob URLs, favicon ICOs, explicit unoptimized inputs, and unauthorized remote URLs (per Astro documented policy).
Rich-text img nodes, CSS background decorations, video preview images and tracking pixels were not next/image renderers.
deploymentBoundary: Published Document pages now default to /api/story-list. The production companion server renders pagination with the shared image pipeline. Split static/Node hosting must forward /api/story-list and /_image on the public origin; scripts/serve-astro-site.cjs supports LUMEN_SERVER_ORIGIN for this arrangement. Client-only templates remain available only for manually constructed contexts without an endpoint.

verification.unit: pnpm test:astro: 241 tests passed across 55 files in the final run.
verification.typecheck: astro check: zero errors, warnings or hints.
verification.images: pnpm test:astro:images verifies static and Node SSR actual image bytes, format/dimensions, crop, densities, preload, SVG passthrough, public assets, responsive browser selection, fill layout, and placeholder cleanup.
verification.paginationImages: pnpm test:astro:story-images passed: real static build, production published route/page loader, upstream CMS SDK requests, runtime responsive AVIF optimization, browser pagination/search/history, and malformed source/list/page rejection.
